points.title: 阿卡德皇帝
points.description: 纳拉姆辛早期在位期间，巩固了阿卡德的中央权威，并开始扩张领土。
points.descriptionEn: During the early part of his reign, Naramsin consolidated the central authority of Akkad and began to expand the territory.

points.title: 阿卡德皇帝
points.description: 纳拉姆辛鼎盛时期，阿卡德帝国达到顶峰，但中央权威开始衰落。
points.descriptionEn: In the prime of his reign, the Akkadian Empire reached its peak, but the central authority began to decline.

points.title: 阿卡德皇帝
points.description: 晚年，纳拉姆辛面对古提人入侵，尽管努力抵抗，但最终未能阻止阿卡德帝国的衰落。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, facing the invasion of the Gutians, Naramsin tried hard to resist but ultimately could not prevent the decline of the Akkadian Empire.

appraisal.zh: 纳拉姆辛是阿卡德帝国的关键人物，其统治通常被视为该帝国的顶峰，他本人也以伟大的征服者形象载入史册。不过也有研究者指出，他晚年未能有效应对外部威胁，帝国的衰落正随之而来，因此其统治同时标志着阿卡德帝国的极盛与由盛转衰。
appraisal.en: Naramsin is a key figure of the Akkadian Empire, and his reign is generally seen as the empire's peak, with him remembered as a great conqueror. Yet other scholars note that in his later years he failed to respond effectively to external threats, and the empire's decline followed, so his rule marks both the height and the beginning of the fall of the Akkadian Empire.

supporter.zh: 纳拉姆辛是一位伟大的征服者，他的统治时期是阿卡德帝国的黄金时代。
supporter.en: Naramsin was a great conqueror, and his reign was the golden age of the Akkadian Empire.

critic.zh: 纳拉姆辛的统治虽然辉煌，但他的晚年未能有效应对外部威胁，导致阿卡德帝国的衰落。
critic.en: Although Naramsin's rule was glorious, his later years failed to effectively respond to external threats, leading to the decline of the Akkadian Empire.

objective.zh: 纳拉姆辛是阿卡德帝国的关键人物，他的统治标志着该帝国的顶峰和衰落。
objective.en: Naramsin was a key figure in the Akkadian Empire, and his reign marked the peak and decline of the empire.

self.zh: 我将以我的剑和我的智慧统治这片土地。
self.en: I will rule this land with my sword and my wisdom.
